retrievalProfile.description: A gritty 1970s-style collage featuring a central portrait within a circular frame, overlaid with symbolic elements like flags and targets, using high-contrast photography and bold sans-serif type.
triggerTerms: circular portrait collage with target overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured composition centered on a man in a work jacket and hat holding a shotgun, framed by a large white circle. A secondary circular target graphic containing a woman's face is positioned at the bottom center, flanked by a small American flag. The overall tone is somber and politically charged, utilizing a muted color palette with stark white accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure framed by a large geometric circle
Secondary circular target graphic overlapping the primary subject
Diagonal tension created by the shotgun and the flag
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a dark background
coreInvariants: Circular framing device for the primary subject
Target reticle overlay on a secondary portrait
Muted earth tones contrasted with patriotic red, white, and blue

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary male figure is centered and large-scale; secondary female figure is small-scale within a target at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white circular frame surrounding the main subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the main subject's face, move down to the target graphic, then follow the diagonal of the shotgun back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark space outside the central circle and at the bottom for credits.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and black for background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white for the circular frame and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and blue from the flag and hat emblem.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white elements and dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or vibrant modern colors
Limit to earth tones, black, white, and muted primary colors

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke width for body text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'o' in the main title is modified to include a patriotic star and stripe pattern.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the top of the circular frame
Placed in the dark footer area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, rounded display type paired with condensed, utilitarian block text.

preserve: The justified block of text at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, rounded feel of the display type.
Matches the utilitarian feel of the bottom credit block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, gritty photograph of a man in a 70s work jacket and hat holding a shotgun, framed by a large white circle on a black background. Include a small target graphic with a woman's face at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, rounded sans-serif display text at the top, modifying the central 'o' with a star pattern. Add a dense block of justified uppercase sans-serif text at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the main subject framed by a white circle?
Is there a target graphic overlaying a secondary face?
Is the bottom text block justified and uppercase?
Is the color palette muted and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Density of the bottom text block
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the target graphic is semi-transparent over the face.
Check that the white circular frame is perfectly centered.
Verify the display text has a heavy, rounded weight.
Confirm the bottom text is legible but densely packed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central circular-framed portrait with a secondary target-overlaid portrait, using a dark background and bold, geometric sans-serif typography for a 1970s cinematic aesthetic.
